description: Дані про споживання комунальних ресурсів (електроенергія, теплова енергія, природний газ, вода) is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Яремчанська міська рада. Набір містить інформацію про споживання комунальних ресурсів. Coverage: Яремчанська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Яремчанська міська рада. Its keywords include брикети, вугілля, електроенергія, природний газ, теплоенергія. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2019-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
